title: Deployment diagram for rustinfer: Release 1, one node
intro: Release 1 runs on one Linux host with its own Instinct GPUs; nothing is distributed and nothing is a service yet. The checkpoint stays where it was downloaded; the artifact cache holds only what the build produced.

nodes.name: Linux host

children.name: rustinfer CLI
children.tech: Rust binary, LLVM 23 linked in process

children.name: Tuning catalog
children.tech: file per target, beside the cache

children.name: AMD Instinct GPUs
children.tech: MI300X (gfx942) or MI355X (gfx950), up to 8, Infinity Fabric

nodes.lede: Everything Release 1 needs, on one machine: the binary, the files it reads and writes, and the GPUs behind ROCm.

nodes.name: CI runners
nodes.tech: GitHub Actions; gpu-test runners on request

children.name: GPU tests
children.tech: a gfx942 and a gfx950 host

nodes.lede: Where every change is built and tested; the GPU tests run on request on hosts with the hardware.
